data.description: Zabeel View | 150 Meters from Dubai Mall
data.display_address: Downtown Views II, Zabeel 2, Zabeel, Dubai
data.long_description:
This brand new two-bedroom is located on a lower floor which perfectly overlooks the lush green Zabeel gardens

The floor to ceiling windows in the living/dining area give the apartment the WOW factor & let in an abundance of natural daylight. The apartment has a white glossy finish which gives the residence a modern and luxurious look.

The tower is a short walk from the Dubai Mall (150 meters) and also has easy access from the financial road, (you avoid the boulevard traffic). Come and have a look for yourself:

The Apartment:
-2 bedroom
-View of Zabeel
-1,084.89 sq.ft (100.79 sq.m)
-2 Bathrooms
-Lower floor
-Floor to ceiling windows
-Balcony
-Easy access from the financial road. (you avoid the boulevard traffic).
-Tower is adjacent to DIFC (Dubai International Financial Center)

-1 Parking included

THE TOWER IS A SHORT WALK FROM THE DUBAI MALL (150 METERS)

Amenities:

-Pool and state of the art gym on podium level with Burj Khalifa view
-Short Walk to the Dubai Mall (150 meters)
-Kids pool and play area

-Basketball/play court
-Residence lounge
-Hotel style reception lobby on ground level
-Landscaped area and park with benches around the tower, perfect for evening stroll.

Dubai Mall Zabeel Extension shops:
-Supermarket (Grandiose)
-LULU Hypermarket
-Pharmacy (Bin Sina)
-Gym (TRAIN)
-Costa Coffee
-Luna Caffe
-Restaurants
-Air-conditioned Connection Bridge to Dubai Mall Fashion Avenue & much more!
